verdict.rationale: Creating and running virtual machines is a fair question for an operating system, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a Windows VM-creation feature, let alone one that needs no manual configuration. The community mentions of running Windows as a guest VM under Linux and of WSL Ubuntu userland support do not show Windows itself quickly creating and running VMs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can quickly create and run virtual machines without manual configuration
